name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Authless)
description: A template for deploying remote Model Context Protocol servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication. It enables users to define custom tools and access them through an SSE endpoint from clients like Cloudflare AI Playground or Claude Desktop.
